citations.title: Doxis Summit 2026: Doxis Unveils Latest Document Intelligence Innovations - Doxis
excerpts: (June 17, 2026 - Bonn) Doxis, The Document Intelligence Company, unveiled a new generation of AI-powered Document Intelligence innovations at the Doxis Summit 2026.

At largest Summit to date, Doxis unveiled next-generation AI innovations including **Ask Doxi, Agent Manager** and **enhanced Superhuman Search** , enabling organizations to turn enterprise knowledge into trusted answers, governed [automation](https://www.doxis.com/en/glossary/automation) and business value

**Ask Doxi** – A new context-aware AI assistant that helps users move from searching to understanding, enabling natural language access to enterprise content with fully traceable answers and source references.

**Agent Manager** – New capabilities for creating and governing enterprise [AI agents](https://www.doxis.com/en/blog/agentic-ai) , giving organizations greater visibility, control and trust as AI takes on more autonomous tasks.

**Enhanced Superhuman Search features** – Designed to improve search experience, combining metadata, full-text, vector and AI-powered search technologies to deliver faster, more accurate and trustworthy answers across enterprise information.

basis.reasoning: The June 17, 2026 announcement introduces Ask Doxi, Agent Manager, and an enhanced Superhuman Search. This is a product-feature launch within the six-month window.
